subject: [PATCH 48/60] mm/madvise: restrict reclaim advice to reclaim-capable memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series restricts the reclaim advice to only memory that is capable of being reclaimed, bypassing node filter reclaim uses and acting only on common memory. It introduces a new function `folio_allows_reclaim()` which checks if the folio's node permits reclaim, and uses this instead for MADV_COLD, MADV_PAGEOUT, and MADV_FREE advices.
